newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Nov CPI rose 1.52 percent - Banco de Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Nov CPI rose 1.52 percent - Banco de Mexico.

text.p: Mexico's consumer price index rose 1.52 percent in November from the month before after rising 1.25 percent in October, Banco de Mexico said.
The central bank added that the producer price index, excluding crude oil exports, rose 1.69 percent in November from the month before, compared to a rise of 1.68 percent in October.
A survey of 10 Mexican brokerages and research companies by Reuters found expectations of a rise of 1.56 percent for November's CPI.
The central bank said that compared with the same month a year earlier the CPI was 27.77 percent higher.
The accumulated inflation rate for the first 11 months of the year was 23.74 percent.
It said that the basic basket of consumer goods rose 1.92 percent in November from the month before.
